title: Allow to filter interface types
description: Allow to only use interface types, that are allowed by the implementing applications.

notes.body: mentioned in merge request !6619
For whatever reason I was not able to test this with logwolf, but only with Wireshark itself. I seem to not be able to use extcap interfaces with logwolf?
54553de59d added an "extlog" directory for Logwolf. You should be able to copy one of the existing extcaps over in order to test. Adding a log-specific extcap/extlog is on my to-do list.

Would it not make more sense, to handle both in the same directory, but add a trigger provided by the extcap, which will explain the suitability for being used with logwolf? That way, you could have ext caps handling both applications. 

Also, the reason why I fell into this trap was, that you changed the global directory, but not the personal one, which still is named extcap in the help dialog (as the whole help dialog is not changed yet appropriately)
It might. I was assuming that we would have separate packet and log extcaps, but !5876 shows that that might not be the case. I'll revert 54553de5 for now.
